appDescription: PickMeUp notifies a saved pickup recipient of the driver's expected arrival, starting navigation to their saved meeting place and preparing a live vehicle-location and estimated-arrival link. Text messages follow the saved immediate-send setting. It also reports recipient readiness and ends pickup sharing.

function.name: START_PICKUP_SHARE
function.description: Notify a saved pickup recipient of the driver's expected arrival by starting navigation to their default meeting place and preparing a live location and estimated-arrival link once guidance is confirmed. If the saved immediate-send setting is enabled, request text delivery for the newly started share without another confirmation; otherwise leave it awaiting explicit approval in the app. If no meeting place is saved, use the current navigation destination.

recipientAlias.description: The recipient's name or alias in the application's saved pickup contacts.

function.name: GET_PICKUP_STATUS
function.description: Report the active pickup, latest estimated arrival freshness, and recipient readiness.

function.name: STOP_PICKUP_SHARE
function.description: End the active pickup share and revoke its recipient access.
